pin_policy: Pin the upstream commits matching the RELEASED build players run, not the tip of `upcoming`. Elite Redux cuts releases from `upcoming` with no tag or release branch. ABILITIES_COUNT is a necessary but NOT sufficient check -- it can hold across a long run of unreleased commits, so do not rely on it alone to pick a SHA. Earlier pins: v2.65beta (er-config 123fc66, 2026-03-27, fixed by direct observation of a real v2.65.3b ROM), an Oct 6 pin (er-config 7285071) that was v2.65.4, and v2.65.4.1b (er-config 8b1d29d / eliteredux-source dd34f57, 2026-10-19). The current pin (v2.65.5, 2026-11-02 release) is er-config 0572570b410dba7a990378b65ff19c552980706f (2026-11-01T21:36:00Z) with eliteredux-source 60f7d528c68d617c5aa91b99f686c7c92316dc1d (2026-11-01T21:36:20Z). Evidence: ER-nextdex commit d51e0c1 ('reset v2.65.5 data with correct commit') reset er-config from unreleased tip b26e790 to 0572570, yielding 1084 abilities matching AbilityEnum.proto at 0572570 (ids 0-1083). Caveats: the source in-game version string was still 'v2.65.4.1' at 60f7d52, bumped to 'v2.65.4.2' later in c88f754 (2026-11-02T00:25Z). tests/test_oracle.py asserts ABILITIES_COUNT and species data against ER-nextdex's published (released-game) data -- keep that green when repinning.
